title: Dynamic Model Merging Made Slim
abstract: arXiv:2605.18904v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Model merging consolidates independently fine-tuned checkpoints without joint training or access to task data. Dynamic methods retain task-specific capacity, but must divide a limited storage budget between shared and expert parameters. We propose DiDi-Merging, which jointly allocates low-rank capacity to these components through differentiable rank selection, followed by data-free parameter-space refinement. On the eight-task ViT-B/32 benchmark, the small configuration reaches 89.3% average accuracy (98.7% normalized retention) at 1.24x the storage of one backbone, including that backbone; the medium configuration reaches 89.8% at 1.4x. Removing refinement reduces the medium configuration by 4.3 percentage points, while static-merge plus uniform-recovery controls are 4.7-8.9 points below the small configuration. translated_title: 动态模型合并的瘦身之道
translated_abstract: 模型合并能够在无需联合训练或访问任务数据的情况下，将独立微调的检查点整合在一起。动态方法保留了任务特定的容量，但必须在共享参数与专家参数之间分配有限的存储预算。我们提出DiDi-Merging，该方法通过可微秩选择为这些组件联合分配低秩容量，随后进行无数据的参数空间精炼。在八任务ViT-B/32基准测试中，小型配置以单个骨干网络1.24倍的存储量（含该骨干网络）达到89.3%的平均准确率（98.7%的归一化保留率）；中型配置以1.4倍存储量达到89.8%。移除精炼步骤会使中型配置下降4.3个百分点，而静态合并加均匀恢复的对照方法比小型配置低4.7-8.9个百分点。额外的评估还涵盖了在各自报告预算下的语言和多模态模型。（原摘要在此处截断）
tldr: DiDi-Merging通过可微秩选择在共享参数与专家参数之间联合分配低秩容量，并结合无数据的参数空间精炼，在仅1.24倍骨干网络存储的预算下实现了领先的动态模型合并性能。
en_tdlr: DiDi-Merging jointly allocates low-rank capacity between shared and expert parameters via differentiable rank selection followed by data-free parameter-space refinement, achieving state-of-the-art dynamic model merging at only 1.24x the storage of a single backbone.
